comment: Webster is AMAZING if you want to learn psych, TAKE THIS CLASS. His presentations take all class, but are so entertaining and informative. Make sure to do his content checks, they add up at the end. 3 exams, always had a study guide and always contained half of the content tested on. Lock in for the last quarter, final project can be a lot of work.

UofR is so lame for not hiring Dr. Webster. He got me psyched for class—that's a pun—and I learned what a pun is and its place in our language from Dr.Webster. This was the first class in college where the information I learned seemed helpful, interesting, and applicable to life—all thanks to Dr. Webster's teaching style.
The buzzer sounds. The game-winning shot goes up... airball. A perfect reenactment of the psych department's decision not to rehire Dr. Webster.
Great teacher, 10/10, would take again. Webster is the best Psyc 100 Teacher, and he is super funny.  Take Him!!!!!

He was an amazing professor! Made all his lectures engaging and was constantly making the class laugh. He tries very hard to be relatable to his students, and it's hilarious and sweet. Would 100% take again if the opportunity arises. If you are between psych professors... take him!!

Very easy and doable class. Make sure to take additional notes from lectures, as some test questions are what he directly discusses. Also, read the textbook because test questions are drawn from that too. Homework is easy and won't take up too much of your time. The class will get busier with the final project, but he is caring and willing to help.

Took PSYC 100 as a gen ed and now might pursue a minor or double major thanks to Dr Webster. His passion for the subject is unmatched and he wants all his students to thrive. Definitely a challenging course but if you put an effort you will be more than fine. Apparently he is only a visiting lecturer so hopefully the university hires him full time.

My favorite professor I have ever taken. It is no wonder that he has a 5/5 stars rating. Every single class is packed full over information, and presented in an engaging manner. He is always cracking jokes and is obviously passionate about psychology. Before each test he will provide you with a study guide of questions, making tests simple.

Dr. Webster is the most accessible outside of class out of any professor I've had. Although there are a lot of assignments, there are a lot of opportunities for points and they are pretty fairly proportioned. Biggest hack - put a lot into the extra credit question on the tests and earn 3 extra points. He is the PSY 200 prof you should try to get.
Overall, a great teacher and fair grader made lectures interesting super nice guy!
Very sweet, always accessible outside of class.

Dr. Webster genuinely wants all of his students to do well and he's an amazing professor. Take him if you can! His tests can be difficult but he occasionally applies curves and he also gives chances for extra credit on every test. His study guides are great too! He's extremely understanding, friendly, and knowledgeable about psych.

Please please please take Dr. Webster if you have a chance. genuinely one of the best teachers i've ever had, lectures are engaging and funny! work is not too heavy and interesting! couldn't give a higher grade
Very energetic and makes learning fun!
Dr. Webster sometimes gives out questions on the test that are asked differently than what is on the study guide, so be aware of that. But he does give some extra credit problems on tests.

Dr. Webster is a good dude. He looks out for his students and understands that you are a young adult with other obligations and responsibilities. There is a 5 point homework assignment each week from the textbook and short open-note quizzes after each class to ensure you were paying attention. Test are reasonable and depending on class average.

He is very funny and appreciates it when you go to office hours. As long as you care about the class and show a genuine desire to learn, you will do fine in his class. Try not to zone out too much during lectures becuse you will get lost.
Engaging and overall a fun class- just get ready to do a lot of written assignments.

Webster is one of the funniest professors that I have ever had. The content checks can be tricky at times but he usually lets you drop at least three at the end of the semester and he gives points back if a lot of ppl struggled on it. He is so helpful and meets you outside of class to help. I would take it again!
Great professor

Lectures every class, but he tries to make them interesting. Overall the class was a bit boring because of the subject matter but he used good examples. The labs were pretty straightforward but I would have appreciated more specific directions. He's always happy to help and is willing to listen to feedback. Lots of extra credit opportunities!

As a professor Dr. Webster is amazing, one of my favorite professors I have had at UR. The material he teaches is not easy, and I felt he does his best to help students get a grasp on major ideas. This class does require a lot of work, especially labs.

Dr Webster is very enthusiastic and cares a lot. Lectures give you everything you need for tests. Be prepared to put in a lot of work for labs and research reports but it is still manageable especially if you don't wait to do reports in one day. One caveat he is slow at uploading some documents and grades. Probably the best professor I've had here.
He is the best! I appreciated what I learned in Intro to Psych and how he genuinely cares about his students and their wellbeing! Take his classes!

Dr. Webster is easily one of the best professors you will have at UR. He makes his classes interesting and fun and is always available for help outside of class. It is clear he enjoys teaching and has a passion for helping his students succeed.

Dr. Webster is THE BEST. His lectures are super helpful, ESPECIALLY the labs, & his quirky sense of humor makes them funny & enjoyable. He really cares about the subject & his students, & he is ALWAYS available to meet- even if it's several times a week (speaking from experience). The workload can be a lot, but he's well worth it. Please take him!

Dr. Webster is the best educator I've ever had. There is no one else at UR that can teach PSYC 200 nearly as well as he can. He is incredibly smart and genuinely cares about his students. He is also always available to make sure you understand the material. Whatever class he is teaching, drop everything to take it. Live, laugh, love, King Webby

Take this man for your PSY 200 course, he makes it easy as possible while still teaching you everything you need for future labs. There's a textbook but you really don't have to read it as he just lectures everything the following day. Don't be scared of what you hear about PSY 200, he does it right and makes it very manageable.

I love Dr. Webster. I had trouble picking out of the positive words above to describe him and his class because he truly fits all of them. He is SO willing to help students always and this is especially great because the content can be tricky and the workload can be a lot to take on at times. Too many good things to say about Webster TRULY.

King Webby is the GOAT. I cannot recommend him enough. He genuinely cares for his students deeply, and is incredibly helpful and accessible to those of us who struggle to pick things up as fast as others. If you want an A in this class, he will help you make that happen, but you do have to put effort into all of the assignments. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Dr. Webster is by far my favorite professor ever. He's a nerd on the topic (in an endearing way). He truly cares about each student's understanding of the content and their well-being. He is always happy to meet to help you out with any questions. The lectures can be fast-paced but topics are explained well.
If you have to take PSYC200 take him!!

Dr. Webster is literally a gem of a professor and person. He really loves stats and is so knowledgable about it, so he can throughly explain the topic in many different ways. He is a quirky guy which makes the lecture and lab times enjoyable. He cares so much about helping his students and is so accessible outside of class. Literally the best!

Dr. Webster is the absolute man. You should not leave U of R without taking one of his classes. He is always able to meet and genuinely cares about each of his students. He makes tough material understandable and is always there for you. He is only currently teaching PSYC 200, but I hope he eventually teaches other classes. Everyone loves him!!!

Dr. Webster is great! His lectures are entertaining and he is very accessible outside of class. He will always look over a lab or paper and give corrections before you turn it in. He is also very clear in his expectations for tests and always holds great review sessions. He is also a really fun person to chat with!

Dr. Webster is an angel of a professor. I have learning disabilities, he is accommodating & understanding. I have had a very rough semester & he has been accommodating. I once went to his office hours in tears thinking I was a bad student & he calmed me down, I left feeling like I had a handle on this course. I hope I get to take him again!

One of the best professors I've had at UR. He's very funny and makes lectures actually enjoyable. Overall the material is not the most interesting and mostly statistics but he is extremely helpful and available if you need extra help. Very understanding and accommodating. I would definitely take Dr.Webster if you have the chance!!

Dr. Webster was AMAZING. I didn't know how I would do in a psychology statistics class as someone who is not great at math or understanding mathematical concepts. However, Dr. Webster made this class fun and went out of his way to make sure every student understood the content. He is always available to meet about assignments and help his students.

Dr. Webster is such a cool guy! Totally recommend picking him as instructor. Study guides are similar to the test and review sessions REALLY help. His lectures were enjoyable thanks to his humor and straightforward power-points. He's really caring and will help you if you just go to office hours and try your best!

Dr. Webster is one of the funniest professors I have had. The lecture material is not bad at all; he makes exact study guides for the exams, study them and you'll be fine. The labs are a bit more work, but he writes out word for word the write ups you need to do. 5Q online quizzes from the lectures twice a week and he drops a bunch. Take Webster !

Dr. Webster is great! He takes a class that was intimidating and made it very enjoyable. He is also super funny, which makes otherwise tough lectures much more manageable. I highly recommend taking a class with Dr. Webster if you get the chance!
